_meta.notes: The ETA is RP-1's own projection off its budget model rather than a promise, and it is worth showing beside a press that will advance the career by that much. Nothing here stops warp: RP-1's controller destroys itself the moment it sees a rate of zero, so the host widget's existing 1x button already ends an RP-1 warp and a second control would be two buttons doing one thing.

_scene.caption: A fund target standing, so both presses are live and each names what it warps to. No ETA line: the operator ruled that funds needs less, so the reason a press is dark lives in its accessible name.
